maintenance_led.reason: Sells cinema advertising (Noovie preshow, lobby, digital) to brands; not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from private brands and advertisers buying cinema ad inventory.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through advertising sales across theater network partners (AMC, Cinemark, Regal), not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can shift budgets to other media easily; cinema advertising is discretionary, though exclusive theater network access gives some scale.
